findings.title: Metamask discloses security incident affecting its infrastructure
findings.summary_md: Sergiu Gatlan reports that MetaMask disclosed an ongoing infrastructure security incident, saying there is no immediate threat to MetaMask wallets and that affected validators in its non-custodial staking operations are being proactively exited in coordination with clients and partners. Lido Finance separately said MetaMask Staking (ex Consensys Staking) is exiting its ETH validators from the Lido protocol, with the final validators expected to be exited, though not fully withdrawn, by the end of October 7, 2026. Lido warned the move will likely incur foregone rewards as well as possible downtime penalties.

findings.title: User update: MetaMask is responding to an incident affecting infrastructure
findings.summary_md: MetaMask's public statement carries a September 30, 2026 update disclosing an ongoing security incident affecting part of its infrastructure, addressed internally with external partners and security advisors, and an October 1 update confirming it worked with partners to take the precautionary step of exiting affected validators. The company states there is no indication that MetaMask wallets or customer funds have been affected, that containment and verification continue, and warns users never to share their Secret Recovery Phrase or private keys.
